source_evidence: Exact player 'yes' accepts the immediately proposed action of presenting actual Crownsunder frontier inquiry commission, limited diplomatic messenger credentials and Ossent delivery acknowledgment, and demanding inspection of the detachment's requisition orders. V holds up those actual papers from the wooded rise, makes them available for inspection and requests the officer's orders; Cirren corroborates their genuine investigative remit, meaningful Help, no claim that the unsigned counterproposal is a treaty. Neither V nor party advances beyond current positions, no originals surrendered to armed men and no papers read from beyond legible distance. Predeclared V Persuasion +6 proficiency/CHA and +1 attuned Luckstone =+7 with Cirren's Help advantage; DC16 engage with credentials and explain authority, DC21 additionally secure temporary pause of requisition. Genuine executed user-visible Python secrets receipt b37f80431b128d6b8f424139cb754fc2 d20 faces2,9 keep9 +7=16 meets DC16, does not meet DC21. No Knack/Commanding Presence/Past Life expenditure authorized or needed for basic success. P1 Veteran responds to the challenge rather than immediately dismissing party: claims requisition was verbally authorized by frontier command and refuses to show any written requisition orders, arguing they are on operational duty and V has no right to halt it. He offers to inspect V's papers if V approaches alone, without actually reading/accepting them or conceding authority, and directs P4 verbally to continue collecting the station's stores. P4 remains at fixed east approach as instruction is delivered, no confiscation, civilian injury, signal, attack or new forced time adjudicated yet. P1's claim is spoken unverified cover, not established genuine military authority, no new fabricated document/lead or identity revelation. Cirren notes the discrepancy between claimed lawful requisition and inability to produce written orders. V has not accepted invitation to approach alone. All fixed positions, numbers, civilian dispositions, stats and other facts retained; next actionable choice at D356~10:13. No initiative, V limited resource use, coin or custody change.
